name: Firefox
best: Sign in to a Firefox Account on both computers (Menu, then Sign in). Passwords and bookmarks sync automatically and stay encrypted the whole way.
export: Menu, then Passwords. Click the three dots at the top right, then Export passwords. Save the file to your USB drive, carry it over, and use Import from a file in the same menu on the new computer.

name: Google Chrome
best: Sign in to the same Google account on both computers and turn on sync. Passwords move across automatically.
export: Profile icon, then Passwords and autofill, then Google Password Manager. Open Settings inside it and choose Export passwords. On the new computer use Import in the same place.

name: Microsoft Edge
best: Sign in with the same Microsoft account on both computers and turn on sync.
export: Settings, then Profiles, then Passwords. Click the three dots and choose Export passwords, then Import on the new computer.

name: Brave
best: Use Brave Sync: Settings, then Sync, and pair both computers with the sync code.
export: Settings, then Passwords and autofill, then Password Manager. Use Export, then Import on the new computer.
